summary: Frontend-only regression test for the beat-sync rework of Jelly Jukebox (#/rhythm-game). Verified (1) audio unlock overlay dismisses on tap, (2) JMA 'Play One, Skip One' song starts a run and renders rhythm-game-playing, (3) falling notes keep spawning without deadlock (.bell-tap-now-halo progressed 1→2→3→4→6→7 over 10s), (4) backing-track audio currentTime advanced 0.84 → 9.95 (playing, not paused), (5) tapping bell-C 5x caused zero crashes, (6) Classic 'Ode to Joy' (no audioUrl / no bpm) still renders playing screen with notes falling (halos 2→6 within 3s) and correctly has no backing-track element. No deadlock from the syncReady gate.

console_warnings.issue: React warning repeated multiple times: 'Encountered two children with the same key'. Likely a non-unique key= in a mapped list (notes/lanes/falling notes). Not blocking gameplay but should be fixed.

action_items: Investigate and fix the 'two children with the same key' React warning in RhythmGamePage during a playing run (likely falling-notes map using a non-unique key).
critical_code_review_comments: Beat-sync regression: PASS. syncReady gate opens properly in both audio-backed (JMA) and non-audio (Classic) songs; the two-rAF measurement + leadInRef path does not block spawning.

No in-game exit/back-to-menu button exists during the 'playing' state — only menu/back-button and results-screen 'Pick Song'/'Home'. If product wants mid-run exit, add a data-testid="exit-game-button". Not a regression, flagged for QA ergonomics.
seed_data_creation: none; only localStorage flag jma_player_name_skipped_v1 was set during tests to bypass the name prompt — this does not persist on fresh users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On a fresh browser, both the audio-unlock overlay (dismiss by click anywhere) AND the PlayerNamePrompt (data-testid=player-name-prompt, skip button data-testid=player-name-skip, or set localStorage key jma_player_name_skipped_v1=1 before load) block interactions. Dismiss both before clicking song cards. There is NO in-run exit button, so to switch songs either wait for finish, reload, or use the back-button in the menu after game ends. The backing-track <audio> element is only mounted when selectedSong.audioUrl is set (JMA Originals); Classic/MiniJams have no <audio data-testid=backing-track>.
